verdict.rationale: Error tracking is a fair axis for an observability platform like Datadog, but the evidence pack never documents errors being grouped into issues, stack traces, or regression detection. The APM, Watchdog and Dynamic Instrumentation items are bare titles with no description of error issue grouping. The only adjacent signal is a generic integrations-directory line about tracking code changes and deployments, which does not show errors grouped into issues or regressions detected, so the core of the story is unevidenced.
